about.description: Teak House Thai Restaurant serves fresh quality Thai food in a comfortable atmosphere. With extensive knowledge of Thai tradition and a rich palette of spices, skilled chefs create classical Thai cooking. All dishes are made to order using only the freshest ingredients and 100% trans-fat-free vegetable oil. Wide variety of vegetarian dishes available.
about.elevator_pitch: Voted Best Asian Restaurant on the Gulf Coast, Teak House offers authentic Thai cuisine with fresh ingredients and traditional flavors in a comfortable, affordable setting.
about.vibe: Comfortable and welcoming dining atmosphere focused on authentic Thai culinary experience
about.reservations: Recommended for large or special parties
